packageRules.description: Lint job Python stays on 3.14: cmake-lint (cmakelang 0.6.13, unmaintained since 2021) crashes on Python 3.15 with 'Cannot use capturing groups in re.Scanner'. Lift once cmake-lint is replaced or fixed.
forgejo/upload-artifact is not on github.com: look its tags up on code.forgejo.org (the instance resolves it from a local mirror of that repo).
Group all GitHub Actions bumps into one PR.
Group all pre-commit hook bumps into one PR. Covers pre-commit-hooks, reuse-tool, shellcheck-py, cmake-format-precommit in .pre-commit-config.yaml.
Major bumps require manual review — surface as checkboxes on the Dependency Dashboard, do not open the PR automatically, do not auto-merge. Minor/patch still flow through automerge gated by CI.
